review.note: Recessed penthouse enclosure only; clip exterior-view context walls to this footprint so roof/parapet projection lines do not become full-height facade walls.
profile_notes: Page13 inner wall rectangle around the mechanical spaces is the penthouse facade; its outer nested rectangles are lower-roof/parapet projections and must not become another tall storey. Plan coordinates are approximate registered feet. Page15 roof outline independently follows approximately the same inner rectangle.

top.note: Historical penthouse roof EL711 minus Level1 EL552 =159ft relative. This top applies only to the penthouse shell, not to ambiguous floorR. Survey datum, roof buildup and parapets remain unverified.

review.note: Internal elevator/mechanical mezzanine. No separate exterior storey or shell; elevation remains unknown. It must not interrupt the full penthouse exterior span.
Composite roof reference sheet, explicitly marked ROOF(TBD). It does not define a new occupied storey or single reliable floor elevation.

envelope_review.method: Source plan outlines were reviewed in the existing registered building frame. This is coarse exterior massing: door/window gaps are closed, glazing and masonry are not distinguished, small facade returns/columns/entrance canopies are simplified. No room, original wall, height, material or measured thickness is inferred from these profiles.

sources.title: UT ECJ floor-plan set in the project
sources.evidence: PDF pages1–15: broad basement/first-floor podium, repeating rectangular tower facade on pages4–12, and recessed mechanical penthouse on page13. Page14 is an internal mezzanine, while page15 is a composite roof sheet marked ROOF(TBD).

sources.title: Sarlo2018 dissertation Appendix C: WJE2013 record elevations
sources.evidence: PDF pages189–190, WJE sheetsS3.2/S3.1: penthouse roof elevation711ft and Level1 elevation552ft imply a159ft relative penthouse top. This is a historical drawing elevation with original vertical datum unspecified; it does not assign a unique elevation to the composite R sheet.

envelope_review.limitations: Horizontal traces and existing floor registration are approximate; lower-level source clipping, facade recesses, terraces, shafts and renovation currency remain unverified. The 0.5 ft inward shell thickness is display-only. Closed shell surfaces include doors and windows without claiming their locations/materials. This is not an as-built envelope, weatherproofing model, or RF obstruction model.
